steps.en: Install the package (Python API and CLI come together)
steps.zh: 安装这个包（Python API 和命令行一起装上）

steps.en: Download the page, or pass in HTML you already fetched
steps.zh: 下载页面，或者直接交入你已抓好的 HTML

steps.en: Ask for the main text in the format you want, with metadata
steps.zh: 按你要的格式要正文，顺带元数据

steps.en: Parses the HTML and keeps the block that looks like the article, dropping nav, footers and widgets
steps.zh: 解析 HTML，留下最像正文的那块，丢掉导航、页脚和小组件

steps.en: If the result is too short, retries with readability and jusText and keeps the better one
steps.zh: 结果太短就换 readability 和 jusText 再试，留更好的

steps.en: Reads title, author and date from the page's markup and returns everything in your format
steps.zh: 从页面标记里读出标题、作者、日期，按你的格式一起返回

value.en: Clean article text plus metadata from any site, without writing a selector per domain
value.zh: 任何网站都能拿到干净正文和元数据，不用按域名写选择器

sources: https://github.com/adbar/trafilatura README.md — opening example (from trafilatura import fetch_url, extract; downloaded = fetch_url(...); extract(downloaded, output_format="json", with_metadata=True)); Features (own extractor with jusText and readability-lxml as fallbacks; metadata)

https://github.com/adbar/trafilatura docs/quickstart.rst — pip install trafilatura; extract(downloaded, output_format="markdown", with_metadata=True); Fast mode note (cascade of own rules, then readability and jusText)
https://github.com/adbar/trafilatura docs/troubleshooting.rst — 'Trafilatura works on raw HTML' (no JS rendering)
https://github.com/adbar/trafilatura pyproject.toml — dependencies (lxml, urllib3, htmldate, justext, courlan), requires-python >=3.10
